2	and Vayelech, and then we enter Rosh HaShanah, my teachers and gentlemen.	e Vayelech, e depois entramos em Rosh HaShaná, meus mestres e senhores.
3	No matter what has been until today, you are going to be
4	standing firm, in order to walk afterward a whole year.	em pé, firme, para depois caminhar um ano inteiro.
5	Nitzavim: if you are standing, if you stand strong,
6	you stand before the King, you say the right
7	words, you are going to a whole year. If you are
8	standing, you will begin to walk. You have a whole year
9	to walk to the best places in the world. You begin
10	to walk. How? If you come standing, you come to Rosh HaShanah.	a caminhar. Como? Se você vem firme, você vem para Rosh HaShaná.
11	In the whole Siddur we do not make requests, we do not ask about
12	the property tax, we do not ask for anything, we only speak
13	of one thing. Master of the world, today we have one sentence:
14	we wanted to tell You what we came to ask of You. Well, open
15	the Siddur: Master of the world, we want You to be King of
16	the world. You are the King. May it be Your will that all know that You are
17	the King. Every creature will know that You made it, every
18	being will understand that You formed it, and everything that has breath in its nostrils will say:
19	HaShem, Elokei Yisrael, is King, and His kingship
20	rules over all. You, HaShem, will reign over all Your works. You
21	will be King over the whole world. The Holy One, Blessed Be He, says:
22	Excuse me, you have
23	this one sentence, this is what you have to say. Make a request, ask
24	for your wife, ask for the children, ask to live a good,
25	sweet year? No, Master of the world, I have no
26	requests like that. Open the Siddur: what are the requests in
27	the Siddur that our Sages, of blessed memory, arranged for us?
28	To crown the Holy One, Blessed Be He, as King over
29	the whole world. All the shofar blasts are to crown You, all
30	the shofar blasts: that You are the King. The Holy One, Blessed
31	Be He, says: So you care about me? You only care
32	that I be
33	King? I care about your property tax, I care about
34	your wife and the children, I care about your income,
35	I care about your health. I will give you everything, because
36	whoever relates to Me and wants Me to be the King, I
37	give him everything: contentment, joy. And therefore may there be
38	for everyone a good and blessed year.	para todos um ano bom e abençoado.
